Figure 15.2 Segmentation
Segmentation consists of ringlike contractions along the 
length of the small intestine. Within a matter of seconds, 
the contracted segments relax and the previously relaxed 
areas contract. The oscillating contractions thoroughly 
mix chyme within the small intestine lumen.
